reviews.text: This daycare center has been my JR Killua's favorite place ever since. And it always has been, even though he only comes here sporadically now. The reason is simple: the kids, Romina, and the entire facility are one of the best things Milan has to offer our furry friends. Clean facility, professionalism, and expertise. Helpfulness and respect. I haven't yet found a daycare center that can match "Vita da cani," because passion and commitment aren't enough to create something beautiful; it takes the right people with a shared goal, and I found them here. Thank you for everything from Killua 🙏🏼 and from us 🤍
